about: Labelled candidate filings for the Patent Secret Signals rules in skills/last30days/references/patent-signals.md. These are constructed cases, one per rule, not saved digests: the filings are invented to show a rule and say nothing about any real company's filings. Per candidate: kind is 'first publication' unless stated ('continuation', 'divisional', 'grant published earlier' and 'design' are counted by the digest and never signals). titles_only is true for an entry the digest lists by title, with no abstract or first claim. concrete is true when the first claim and abstract name a device, material, user or use a reader can picture. paths lists which paths of the bar the candidate meets (1 out of character, 2 a recognisable product the company has not shipped or announced, 3 bears on a story in the report). shipped_match is true when the web check found a shipped or announced product that matches, false when it found none, null when it was not checked while labelling; covered is the same for coverage of the filing. name_matched is true for an entry the digest marks name-matched; entity_known is then true when the filing entity is known to belong to the company, false when known not to, null when not known. location_contradicts is true when the applicant location plainly contradicts the company. A candidate with a cluster list is several filings that share one specific focus; members that share one priority date and one filed_as name are one invention family. jobs_signals is how many signal paragraphs the same report's Jobs Page Secret Signals section has.
